description: This file defines the implementation of the Shutdown class within the firebolt::rialto::server::tasks::generic namespace. It includes constructor, destructor, and execute method implementations for shutting down a generic player, with logging statements.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class responsible for handling the shutdown process of a generic player, including logging and stopping the worker thread.

methods.name: Shutdown::Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown object with a reference to the IGstGenericPlayerPrivate interface and logs construction.

methods.name: Shutdown::~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs when shutdown is finished.

methods.name: Shutdown::execute
methods.description: Executes the shutdown process by logging and calling stopWorkerThread on the player.
